purpose: The seeds and levels of the published chaos benchmark (ADR 0014), fixed before any benchmark ran.
rule: The first 20 seeds from 1000 upward, at levels 2, 3, and 5. Development used seeds 0-299 at level 3 and 20-119 at level 5 (Phase 5's survey, Phase 6's known failures and held-out seeds), the pair tables use seeds up to 34, and tests use 424242, so no seed here shaped any rule, weight, threshold, or prompt.
